companyName: Byggmästare Anders J Ahlström Holding AB (publ)
profile: Byggmästare Anders J Ahlström Holding AB is an investment company focused on active ownership and long-term value creation. It invests primarily in small and medium-sized companies in Sweden and the rest of the Nordics, in both listed and unlisted holdings. The company seeks businesses with scalable models, strong management and organic or acquisition-driven growth opportunities.
